evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.045 Torr at stable growth setpoints.
Pressure rose progressively to 3.214 Torr without a setpoint change.
Pressure reached 3.338 Torr, approximately 9.6% above its value at 2640 s, continuing the sustained upward trend.
Temperature 749.5 °C and argon flow 99.1 sccm remain near 750 °C and 100 sccm setpoints; heater power is stable at 46.7%.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; pressure and argon readings cannot establish atmospheric purity.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure confirmation and checks of exhaust conductance and seal integrity are needed to distinguish blockage, leakage, and sensor error; oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere purity. Sample characterization is not yet available.
